templates.why_chosen: Star-rated, the reference doc's own baseline-vs-ours cross-reference for phase-lanes: two column-aligned stacked timelines (Baseline CPU-GEMV, Cocoon-Emb) share iteration boundaries as dotted verticals, with four circled steps and a red Speedup bracket comparing their total lengths.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack the before and after timelines directly on top of each other at the same horizontal scale, mark shared iteration boundaries with dotted verticals so the eye can compare like-for-like, number the optimization steps that shorten the new timeline, and close with one bracket that measures the total speedup.
